comments: Input facts: ego is the sole car and initiator; off-trafficway interaction is permitted. Chosen assumptions: ego starts on the lane centerline with its heading 15-25 degrees to the right of the lane direction, representing an existing steering error. It continues under throttle without correcting that heading. The projected point 18-24 m ahead along that heading is outside the road. Initial speed is 7-9 m/s and throttle is 0.15-0.30, held continuously. No other actors or response policy are introduced; adjacent lanes are not necessary. Outcome intent is lateral road departure rather than a mandated collision.
